_doc: Roster name canonicalization for the Grove Coverage view (Brief 24, Cadastre 2026-05-25). park_trees.json#/trees[].species are messy hand-entered common names with casing / word-order / cultivar duplicates that double-count in a roster-anchored coverage join. This table merges raw names -> a single canonical name BEFORE counting. Operator-edit by hand: this is curation no auto-guess gets right (mirrors park_species_map.json's stance). Any raw name absent here passes through as its own canonical name, so a missing merge stays VISIBLE in the Coverage view (the operator can spot it and add a row). Seeded from the 5 merges listed in arborist/_archive/ROSTER-COVERAGE-2026-08-23.md section intro; many other obvious dups (e.g. 'oak, northern red' + 'Oak, Northern Red', 'Maple, Red' + 'Maple, Red ‘October Glory’') are intentionally NOT merged yet — add them here as you confirm them.
